index.hero-mission: Hawkeye is a free, nonpartisan programme of IniXien Hope Initiative, a Nigerian not-for-profit. Our mission: a public record of the result announced at every polling unit, one any citizen can check.
about.mission-statement: To give every Nigerian a public, checkable record of the result announced at their polling unit, so that the count can be compared openly at every stage of collation. Hawkeye is free to use and serves voters, observers, journalists and every party on the same terms.
about.wwd-observers: Free observer apps for the web, Android and iPhone, so anyone at a polling unit can photograph and sign the announced result.
about.wwd-practice: Practice runs and national practice days, so observers learn the steps before election day.
about.wwd-ledger: A public ledger of every report, which anyone can verify, and a public docket where disputed results are reviewed in the open.
about.wwd-information: Plain information for voters: the races, the candidates INEC has published, and where observers are still needed.
